f2.zh: 我们服务过的家庭与月嫂

f3.en: “Our nanny made the first month with our newborn so much calmer. She knew exactly what to do, and communication was never an issue.”
f3.zh: “月嫂的到来让我们和新生宝宝的第一个月轻松了很多，她非常专业，沟通也完全没有问题。”

f6.en: “The training program gave me the confidence and skills to start this career. I felt genuinely prepared for my first placement.”
f6.zh: “这个培训课程让我有信心和能力开始这份职业，第一次上岗时我感觉自己已经准备得很充分了。”

f9.en: “Professional from the first phone call to the day our nanny left. Highly recommend for any Melbourne family.”
f9.zh: “从第一通电话咨询到月嫂结束服务，整个过程都非常专业，强烈推荐给墨尔本的家庭。”

f12.en: I did my training while based in Queenstown and it completely changed my confidence going into my first placement. The instructors made sure I was ready for real family life, not just theory.
f12.zh: 我在皇后镇接受培训期间信心大增，为第一次上岗做好了充分准备。老师们不仅教授理论，还教我们如何真正融入家庭生活。

f15.en: Training here gave me real, hands-on newborn care experience before I ever stepped into a client's home. I felt supported the whole way through.
f15.zh: 培训课程让我在真正走进客户家庭之前，就已经积累了扎实的新生儿照护实操经验。整个过程我都感受到团队的支持。

f18.en: From the first enquiry to the day our caregiver arrived, everything was smooth and professional. Our family in Brisbane couldn't have asked for better support.
f18.zh: 从最初咨询到护理人员抵达的那一天，整个过程都非常顺畅专业。我们布里斯班的家庭真的非常满意这份支持。
